why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts or daily series were available, so the mechanism behind the successful-search lift is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

why_it_moved.text: Allocation was cut in half on 2026-09-16, so results mix users exposed before and after that edit.
why_it_moved.label: measured

would_change: A re-run, or an analysis limited to days after the 2026-09-16 edit, that shows the lift holds on a stable allocation.
A daily series by days since first exposure, to check the lift is not fading and the early cohort is not driving it.
Even then the lower end of the primary interval sits under the 0.5% bar, so a clean result may still only escalate.
